hooks.name: Run tests when logic changes
hooks.description: Validates every scenario and runs the scoring property tests whenever core.js or the tests change

hooks.name: Accessibility review on UI edits
hooks.description: Asks the agent to check keyboard, Lights on mode and reduced motion after UI changes (read-only, so it cannot retrigger itself)

then.prompt: app.js or index.html changed. Without editing any files, check that every clue is still reachable by keyboard in Lights on mode, that aria-pressed and the aria-live region still work, and that animations stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Report problems only.
